versions.changelog: Add SKILL.md frontmatter so OpenClaw lists and loads the skill

Initial release of PopaDex Finance Copilot Skill.

- Provides read-only financial insights and guidance based on PopaDex personal finance data.
- Supports net worth analysis, account allocation review, salary/tax comparisons, retirement projections, and international disposable income ranking.
- Generates budget Sankey diagrams, portfolio performance reports, historical timelines, CSV exports, and plain-language action plans.
- Enforces safety rules: no transactions, no regulated advice, no write/delete operations; clearly labels all estimates and assumptions.
- Clearly distinguishes between free and premium tool access, providing upgrade guidance if needed.
